name: Cursor
invoke: @mps-<role> in chat to pull the rule in, or paste `mps agents show <role>` into a new chat
notes: Project rules are .cursor/rules/*.mdc with description / globs / alwaysApply; a plain .md there is ignored, which is why the extension matters. alwaysApply: false keeps a role out of every session until it is called by @name. Cursor also reads AGENTS.md, so the routing block reaches it. Cursor has no project-level subagent format — a rule is the closest thing, and the fresh-context contract is on the caller.
